data.hook: Limited-edition Qatar tee in white / red stripes: quick-dry, light, made to move.
why: Quick-drying fabric keeps you comfortable through long rallies
Supple, stretchy fabric for full freedom of movement
Limited Qatar edition design, white with red horizontal stripes, with the Qatar flag
data.summary: A limited-edition Bullpadel playing shirt from the Qatar series, white with red horizontal stripes. Quick-drying, supple fabric gives comfort and freedom of movement on court.

faq.q: Can I try the shirt on before buying?
faq.a: Yes. Tap "Keep it ready for me to see" and we'll have your size at the front desk to try on.
At the club front desk, the same way you pay for court bookings. There is no online payment.

data.clubTake: Brand new, limited run. A standout on court.
